calls.title: Jayson Conway and Ashley Stirrup
calls.summary: The meeting addressed several key areas, including the challenges of integrating LinkedIn event registrations into Zoom, with a reliance on manual processes for reminders. Discussions on the Optimizely campaign highlighted the need for audience size expansion from 828 to approximately 45,000 through targeted filtering. The team aims to boost engagement via a new content strategy with 20 monthly posts and selective boosting based on performance. Automation of LinkedIn outreach was proposed to enhance connections and improve engagement through soft-sell messaging. Lastly, the effectiveness of recent LinkedIn campaigns was reviewed, indicating strong engagement metrics that will guide ongoing optimization efforts.
calls.keywords: LinkedIn Events, HubSpot Integration, Zoom Registration, AI PlayBook, Optimisely Campaign, Thought Leadership, LinkedIn Message Ads, Prospect Outreach, Retargeting Audience
